name: ew-ai-resource-governor
description: Govern Codex and Work AI resources using business policy, allowance, task value, risk, urgency, difficulty, and failure history. / 依企業政策、額度、任務價值、風險、緊急度、難度與失敗紀錄治理 Codex 與工作模式 AI 資源。

author.name: Embodied Worker Co., Ltd. / 具象職人股份有限公司

interface.displayName: EW AI Resource Governor / 具象 AI 資源治理
interface.shortDescription: Business-policy AI workload and credit governance. / 企業政策導向的 AI 工作負載與額度治理。
interface.longDescription: Reads authenticated Codex and Work allowance facts, then evaluates business policy, task value, risk, urgency, difficulty, and failure history to recommend an economical AI resource policy: proceed normally, conserve resources, defer non-urgent work, or justify deeper reasoning for critical work. It governs whether a task deserves more AI resources; it does not duplicate OpenAI model routing, predict reset events, automatically switch models, apply resets, or purchase credits. / 讀取已登入的 Codex 與工作模式額度，再依企業政策、任務價值、風險、緊急度、難度與失敗紀錄提出 AI 資源策略：正常執行、節省資源、延後非緊急工作，或允許關鍵工作使用更深推理。它治理的是工作是否值得投入更多 AI 資源；不重複 OpenAI 的模型調度、不預測重置事件，也不會自動切換模型、執行重置或購買點數。
interface.developerName: Embodied Worker Co., Ltd. / 具象職人股份有限公司
defaultPrompt: Optimize my AI resource use for this task. / 幫我最佳化這項工作的 AI 資源使用。
Check my allowance and decide how much AI resource this work deserves. / 檢查我的額度，判斷這項工作值得投入多少 AI 資源。
Classify this task and recommend a cost-aware work strategy. / 為這項任務分級並建議成本感知的工作策略。
